name: Phú Hòa Đông rice paper
summary: Thin rice-paper sheets from Phú Hòa Đông, poured and dried in the sun. The batter is rice flour, and some batches add coconut water, salt, sugar, and sesame.
origin: xã Phú Hòa Đông, Củ Chi. Quyết định 4568/QĐ-UBND, in Công báo Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh with the gazette date 14 Oct 2024, recognizes nghề sản xuất bánh tráng.
howToEat: The sheets are poured thin, lifted with a bamboo tube, dried in the sun, and stacked to 100. One mix is rice flour with coconut water, salt, sugar, and sesame depending on the batch. An older mix is rice flour, water, and salt.

About 100 kilns, about 40 tons a day, about two-thirds export, and about 6,000 workers sit beside HTV’s 62 establishments: 10 enterprises, 1 cooperative, and 41 business households, plus 20 households still working by hand, and one firm at 15–20 tons a day.

The craft is more than 80 years on one account and more than 50 years on another. The gazette decision gives no start year. Work starts at 2:00 on the magazine visit. A visitor hour is Check on arrival.
where: xã Phú Hòa Đông, on the river. One account says more than about 40 km from the city centre. Another says about 40 km. The commune name stays xã Phú Hòa Đông.
seoTitle: Phú Hòa Đông rice paper in Cu Chi
seoDescription: Thin rice-paper sheets from Phú Hòa Đông, dried in the sun, from rice flour and, on some batches, coconut water, salt, sugar, and sesame.
